name: feature_specification
description: Produces a structured feature specification from a natural-language feature request and project context from the brain. The spec defines boundaries, interfaces, data models, acceptance criteria, and test scope — everything the code engine (000009) needs to implement.

inputs.name: project_context
inputs.description: Brain knowledge graph slice for context-aware spec.

outputs.name: feature_spec
outputs.description: { feature_id: AIOS-FEATURE-NNNNNN, name, boundaries: string[], interfaces: [{name, contract_ref}], data_models: [{name, fields}], acceptance_criteria: string[], test_scope: string[], depends_on_features: string[] }

side_effects: Persists spec to the memory module

error_codes.message: Feature request cannot be turned into a structured spec.
error_codes.recovery: Per Law 12: surface what's missing; request minimal clarification; never fabricate boundaries.

error_codes.message: Feature boundaries overlap with an existing feature.
error_codes.recovery: List the overlapping feature id and suggest merge or re-scoping.

examples: request='user auth with email+oauth' -> feature_spec with 2 auth interfaces, 3 data models, 5 acceptance criteria.
